model_interpretation.claim: Staging each source tile's x, y, z, and mass once in shared memory lets the active target threads in a block reuse those values, potentially reducing repeated global source loads. The interaction order and arithmetic are retained; synchronization and staging overhead may offset any benefit, so the official geometric-mean timing must decide.
